en: A vintage monochrome postcard view of a historic church and surrounding town buildings. The tall central structure is a church with a prominent tower and spire, labelled at the top of the card as "Wenzelskirche." Below, early 20th‑century townhouses and shops line a square with trees and a few pedestrians. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Naumburg a. S., and the publisher credit appears in small type.
